categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, sales, and service of power semiconductor devices. Key products include high-power thyristors, rectifiers, IGBTs, power semiconductor modules, and pulse power switches, widely applied in industrial inverters, motor drives, high-power power supplies, digital energy, smart grids, rail transit, and new energy sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company adopts a vertically integrated IDM model covering wafer processing, chip design, packaging, and testing. It holds 61 semiconductor patents and proprietary technologies, with advanced capabilities in large power semiconductor devices and pulse power switch technology. It actively pursues R&D in third-generation wide bandgap semiconductors such as SiC and GaN, and employs ISO9001, ISO14001, ISO45001, and ISO22163 management systems to ensure quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Customers span various sectors including industrial manufacturing, digital energy, smart grids, rail transit, new energy, and electrical control equipment. The company maintains long-term relationships with leading enterprises in power electronics applications and has a broad customer base with a focus on high-end clients in emerging and traditional markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with domestic sales accounting for over 95% of revenue. It also has limited export sales. Its subsidiaries are located in Shanghai and Xiangyang, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as an integrated manufacturer in the midstream segment of the power semiconductor supply chain, covering chip design, wafer fabrication, packaging, testing, and direct sales to end customers, thus controlling the full production cycle.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include product and market structure optimization, focusing on high-end power semiconductor devices like IGBT modules and IGCTs, and expanding applications in digital energy, pulse power systems, and new energy sectors. The company emphasizes R&D in third-generation semiconductors (SiC, GaN), pulse power switches, and advanced packaging technologies, supported by collaborations with universities and research institutes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales and regional distribution of power semiconductor devices and modules. The company sells physical products, including chips, modules, and components, with a focus on direct sales accounting for nearly 90% of revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is among the leading domestic providers in the large power semiconductor device segment, with strong production capacity, product quality, and market share. It holds a competitive position in motor drive control and industrial manufacturing equipment sectors, with expanding presence in digital and clean energy fields.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 354 million, a 10.76% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 25.29 million, down 18.77% from the previous year. The company maintains a stable asset base of over RMB 1.23 billion and continues to invest significantly in R&D, with an 88.94% increase in net profit excluding non-recurring items.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its vertically integrated IDM model, proprietary technology, and comprehensive product portfolio as key differentiators. It offers high-quality, reliable power semiconductor devices with advanced pulse power switch technology and is committed to innovation in wide bandgap semiconductors. Its strong market presence, quality certifications, and strategic partnerships enhance its competitive advantage.
